record.question: Which of the following article defines the term 'State' for the purpose of Fundamental Rights?
record.explanation: Answer A: Article 12. Article 12 defines “State” for Part III, which contains Fundamental Rights. Reference: https://www.indiacode.nic.in/bitstream/123456789/19632/1/the_constitution_of_india.pdf. Verified worked solution, unofficial. Historical context: October 2025 examination (cover page); answer time-sensitive wording as of then.. Officeholders, survey results and forecasts refer to that original paper, not necessarily the present. No matching examiner key is asserted.
